title: Duke of Vlika
summary: Raleigh names Duke of Vlika in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Duke of Vlika, by whose relation the monuments of the Kings of Iuda remayned. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. IX, sig. 301a
